# Visualization gallery

This page gathers the most common plot patterns that new users want to reproduce quickly. Each recipe is intentionally short and focused so that it can be used as a reference while you work through the longer tutorials.

## Common plot types

- **Scatter plots** — show individual responses in the pleasant/eventful space and are the default starting point for most soundscape analyses.
- **Density and contour plots** — highlight where responses are concentrated and are useful when you want a summary of a distribution.
- **Joint plots** — combine a scatter view with a marginal density view for a compact overview.
- **Multi-panel comparisons** — compare several locations or conditions in one figure.

For the fuller version of these examples, see [Advanced visualization techniques](14-advanced-visualization-techniques.qmd) and [Quick Start](10-quickstart.qmd).
